source: Beginner short story written in spoken Palestinian by Claude. NOT native-validated.

sentences.en: Every day we have breakfast together.
We eat bread, oil, za'tar, and cheese.
My mom makes eggs and mint tea.
I really like oil and za'tar.

sentences.ar: بعد الفطور، كل واحد بروح على شغله.
sentences.en: After breakfast, everyone goes to their work.
